+    def solve(data):
+        jobs = data["jobs"]
+        k = data["k"]
+        blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+        mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))

+            counts = Counter(job["group"] for job in choice)
+            if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+                   for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):

+            active = []
+            valid = True
+            for job in sorted(choice, key=lambda row: (row["start"], row["end"])):

+                active.append(job["end"])

+                      (tie == "smallest" and ids < best_ids)))):
+                best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+
+        if best_value is None:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}

+def _route(data, coupon_rule, minimum_duration):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    initial_mask = sum(1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)
+                       if node == data["source"])
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    start = (data["source"], initial_mask, 0)
+    distances = {start: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], data["source"], initial_mask, 0)]
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if distances.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if (node == data["target"] and mask == full and
+                (coupon_rule == "at_most" or used == data["coupons"])):
+            return {"arrival": time}
+
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            choices = [(edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < data["coupons"]:
+                duration = max(minimum_duration,
+                               edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                choices.append((duration, used + 1))
+            for duration, next_used in choices:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask
+                for i, required_node in enumerate(required):
+                    if next_node == required_node:
+                        next_mask |= 1 << i
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, next_used)
+                if arrival < distances.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    distances[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, next_node, next_mask, next_used))
+    return {"arrival": None}
